name: Adtunis SpeechPrint multi-axis ontology
purpose: Describe speech for accessibility and speech recognition. Not a diagnostic classifier.
rules: Never infer cerebral palsy, cognitive capacity, etiology, or dysarthria subtype from a voice sample.
Diagnosis, motor presentation, dysarthria type, impairment observation, and communication participation are separate axes.
A person may have cerebral palsy without dysarthria and may have several speech or language conditions.
Use unknown/not_assessed rather than filling missing clinical labels from stereotypes.
Feature observations are time-, context-, and method-specific.

diagnosis_families.label: Cerebral palsy
diagnosis_families.relation: Clinical context; optional, with recorded source

diagnosis_families.label: Motor neurone disease / ALS
diagnosis_families.relation: Possible future cohort; do not merge clinically with CP

severity_rule: Optional per-feature ordinal annotations must specify scale, method, rater, date, and confidence; not comparable across cohorts without calibration.
diagnostic_crosswalk_warning: CP motor type and dysarthria type are not interchangeable. CFCS measures real-world communication effectiveness across all modalities and is not an ASR difficulty score.
